items.stimulus: A meteorologist compares temperature readings from two weather stations on the same day. The graph shows the temperature $y$, in degrees Celsius, at Station A, $x$ hours after 6:00 a.m., for $0 \le x \le 10$. The graph is a parabola. items.stem: The two stations record the same temperature at two different times. How many hours after 6:00 a.m. is the later of these two times?
